Marriott International Class A (MAR) Shareholder Scott & Selber Cut Its Holding; Punch & Associates Investment Management Increased Its Position in Seaspan (SSW) by $1.70 Million
May 16, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Scott & Selber Inc decreased its stake in Marriott International Class A (MAR) by 29.56% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Scott & Selber Inc sold 11,238 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.21% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 26,777 shares of the hotels and resorts company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.63M, down from 38,015 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Scott & Selber Inc who had been investing in Marriott International Class A for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $49.04B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.06% or $0.09 during the last trading session, reaching $138.77. About 70,420 shares traded. Marriott International, Inc. (NASDAQ:MAR) has risen 45.53% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 33.98% the S&P500.
Punch & Associates Investment Management Inc increased its stake in Seaspan Corp (SSW) by 44.3% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Punch & Associates Investment Management Inc bought 283,461 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.28% with the market. The hedge fund held 923,283 shares of the marine transportation company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.23M, up from 639,822 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Punch & Associates Investment Management Inc who had been investing in Seaspan Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.22 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.94% or $0.085 during the last trading session, reaching $8.955. About 65,173 shares traded. Seaspan Corporation (NYSE:SSW) has risen 4.08% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 7.47% the S&P500.
Among 13 analysts covering Seaspan ( NYSE:SSW ), 4 have Buy rating, 3 Sell and 6 Hold. Therefore 31% are positive. Seaspan had 22 analyst reports since September 18, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Buy” rating by Seaport Global given on Wednesday, January 24. Bank of America maintained Seaspan Corporation (NYSE:SSW) on Friday, March 2 with “Underperform” rating. The company was upgraded on Thursday, May 3 by Bank of America. JP Morgan initiated the shares of SSW in report on Friday, December 18 with “Underweight” rating. The firm has “Underweight” rating given on Friday, April 1 by Barclays Capital. The rating was upgraded by JP Morgan to “Neutral” on Thursday, March 2.
